  • How: glass berry slopes in the evening (Tip). How to hunt

  • How: walk a Forest Service road edge at first light, then step off the road to shoot (Tip). How to hunt

"★ See Map B9 ▲ See Maps B18, B19"

"Compulsory Inspection Required."

  • 2-6 goats: stay out of the Map B9 closed area. 2-12 goats: stay out of Maps B18 and B19 (95%, my reading; the maps are titled "Mountain Goat Closed Area").
  • Every goat goes to inspection 99%.
Black bear footnote, page 28

"★ The bag limit for black bears is two per licence year (Apr 1 - Mar 31)"

  • 2 bears from 1 April to 31 March, spring and fall together 99%.
Wolf and bobcat lines, page 28

"Compulsory Reporting required"

  • A wolf or bobcat taken in Region 2 must be reported 99%.
Cougar footnote, page 28

"Hunters may not hunt a cougar kitten or any cougar in its company. See Definitions section: cougar kitten. All cougars taken in region 2 must be Compulsory Inspected."

Definitions, page 3

"COUGAR KITTEN - means any cougar with spots or any cougar under one year of age."

  • Never hunt a spotted or young cougar, or a cougar with one. Every cougar goes to inspection 99%.

Grandpa's rule (wisdom, not law)

Read the row, then the map, then the bylaw. In the Fraser Valley the closure is usually the answer.

Common mistakes
  • Shooting a doe in the Stave hills in October because "the limit is 2, one antlerless". There is no antlerless season in 2-8.
  • Hunting ducks on the Fraser at Mission without the special licence and the $1,000,000 insurance.
  • Driving into Pitt Addington Marsh in October. It is closed to vehicles all year.
